tags-input.$description: v0.7 — Wrapping chip-row tag entry. The shell reuses input.* tokens but flexes height (auto, min input.height.md). This file owns the tag-chip surface and the bare draft <input> sizing.

shell.$description: Field-shell delta — wraps to multiple lines, vertical padding adapts.

y.$description: Vertical breathing room when chips wrap to a new row.

wrap.$description: Gap between chips and between chip-row and draft input.

tag.$description: Single tag chip. Pill-radius hairline-bordered surface; close (X) button at the end.

remove.$description: The 'remove tag' close button at the chip's trailing edge.

draft.$description: The bare <input> at the end of the chip row. No border; auto-width.

min-width.$description: 80 px — enough to type a short tag.
